notes.title: Update 1: Children + bug fixes
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/qLIOSEt.gif

Hi, I'm Lucas and I'm the developer of Roguemance.

The most exciting change in this first, small update soon after release is the ability to have children.

At the end of a victorious playthrough, you can choose to have a child with one of your partners. A new single-player game starts with the child as the player character.

Each time you have a child, all enemies gain +1 HP. So each new playthrough gets harder and harder.

Read the full change log:

Update 1 change log


    Players can now have children at the end of a victorious playthrough. A new single-player game starts with the child as the player character.
    Each time you have a child, all enemies gain +1 HP. So each new playthrough gets harder and harder.
    Fixed a bug in the shop where costs were sometimes wrong.
    Fixed a bug in the shop where the player would say "not enough money!" despite having enough.
    Changed a message in the shop from "not enough money!" to "not enough coins!"





If you have any feedback, please let me know in this Discord channel: https://discord.gg/TsaGBWk

Or email me: lucas@roguemance.com

Love you! <3
